text: Consider singleton MCP server with multiplexed transport (HTTP/SSE) instead of per-client stdio processes. Currently each MCP client (VS Code, Copilot CLI) spawns its own backlogit mcp process, each with an independent sql.DB connection pool against the same backlogit.db. A single long-lived server process with HTTP or SSE transport would eliminate multi-process SQLite contention entirely. NOTE: This is a contingency item -- only pursue if fixes 1-4 (busy_timeout increase, write-retry wrapper, BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions, batched rehydration) prove insufficient to address concurrent session reliability. TRIAGE 2026-04-23: All four fixes shipped in 031-F (032-S). Contingency trigger condition not met. Deprioritized to low -- revisit only if multi-process contention recurs under real workloads. Effort: significant -- requires transport layer refactoring and process lifecycle management. Impact: high if needed -- eliminates the root cause of multi-process contention.

Follow-up to feature covering stash A9D74372 (Stage harvest docline hardening): (a) Direction 3 DEFERRED from that chore — change how the Stage harvest commit reaches the Ship feature branch so a Stage-artifact defect (beyond docline frontmatter, e.g. committed-file scope) cannot ride into a Ship PR. Options: Stage pushes its harvest commit to origin/main before Ship branches, or harvest lands via a dedicated delivery mechanism. Larger blast radius (branch/push topology, partly Ship-owned) — evaluate before implementing. (b) Upstream template drift: the docline frontmatter contract + pre-harvest lint gate were applied to the in-repo .github/skills/impl-plan/SKILL.md and harvest/SKILL.md, but the generating .tmpl sources live in the external autoharness repo; update them there (never via out-of-tree writes from this workspace, per Principle IV) so a regeneration does not overwrite the fix. Source: plan-review of docs/exec-plans/2026-07-02-stage-harvest-docline-frontmatter-hardening-plan.md, 2026-07-02.

Provision npm publishing credentials for @backlogit (EXTERNAL, human-only follow-up carved out of 080-S / stash 9140F65C in-repo slice): (1) provision the @backlogit org/scope on npmjs.org; (2) create an npm automation token with publish rights and add it as repo secret NPM_TOKEN. No agent (Stage or Ship) can perform these -- they require npm-org and repo-secret provisioning. Once done, the NPM_TOKEN presence guard shipped in task 080.001-T lets the release.yml npm-publish job's publish steps run automatically on the next release (no workflow change needed).

DIAGNOSIS 2026-07-04: Root cause of the v1.3.0 npm-publish failure (run 28488788268, job 84441217752) confirmed = npm error code E404 "PUT https://registry.npmjs.org/@backlogit%2flinux-x64 - Not found / is not in this registry". The existing NPM_TOKEN authenticated successfully (npm built the tarball; no ENEEDAUTH/EOTP) -- 404-on-PUT is npm's signal that the authenticated account does NOT own the @backlogit scope. So the token is valid; the missing piece is that the @backlogit organization/scope is not provisioned under the token's npm account. Fix = create npm org named "backlogit" (claims @backlogit scope) owned by / with the NPM_TOKEN user as a publisher; then validate with a prerelease tag (e.g. v1.3.1-rc.1) which triggers release.yml and actually attempts publish (--access public already set; platform packages publish before the wrapper). No repo/workflow change required unless the "backlogit" org name is unavailable (then rename all 6 npm/*/package.json + release.yml publish loop to a new scope).

Reduce CI build actions to only run on code changes to save GitHub Actions usage. Add path/PR-title gating to the build/test workflows (.github/workflows/) so docs- and chore-only PRs skip the heavy Go build/test/lint jobs. Candidate strategies: (1) paths-ignore: on push/pull_request (e.g. skip when only docs/**, *.md, .backlogit/**, docs/** change); (2) PR-title gating on the build jobs, e.g. if: | !startsWith(github.event.pull_request.title, 'chore:') && !startsWith(github.event.pull_request.title, 'docs:'); or a paths-filter action (dorny/paths-filter) that sets an outputs flag consumed by downstream job if:. Considerations: keep required status checks satisfiable (a skipped required check can block merge under branch protection — use a always-pass 'gate' job or GitHub's 'required workflow with path filter' pattern, or make the check non-required); ensure the Docline frontmatter gate and CLI Reference Drift checks still run where relevant; must not weaken security-sensitive gates. Source: operator request 2026-07-04 (save on GitHub build-action usage limits).

Derive an indexed SQLite column for pre-task-completion gate evidence to enable queryability (follow-up to gate-broker Q3, feature D23DFA0B). Decision Q3 stores gate evidence in item logs only (not frontmatter) for merge-conflict hygiene. This follow-up adds a DERIVED, indexed column (e.g. items.last_gate_evidence_sha / gate_status, or a dedicated gate_evidence table) populated from the item_log_entries during sync_index/rehydration, so agents can query 'which done tasks have/lack gate evidence at HEAD' without scanning logs. Must be a read-model projection built from the append-only logs (logs remain source of truth); rebuilt on backlogit sync. Enables the doctor --check-gate-evidence check (Q2) to run as an efficient indexed query and supports future strict-mode enforcement. Depends on D23DFA0B gate-broker landing first (evidence events must exist). Source: gate-broker deliberation Q3, operator 2026-07-05.
